refs.title: Fire pillar over red ground telegraph
refs.summary: A tall white-hot fire column erupts from a red ring on a stone courtyard in a mass PvP siege; the frame carries a chromatic-aberration glitch transition and floating damage numbers.
lessons: Telegraph AoE with a flat semi-transparent red ellipse decal (~25% screen width) before/under the pillar so the hit area is readable from an isometric camera.
Pillar is layered: white overexposed core > yellow/orange flame edges > bloom wash that bleaches the surrounding ground; the overexposure itself sells power.
Large stacked damage numbers (4-digit, white with dark outline) float above targets in clusters; keep them above the impact, not on it.
An RGB-split glitch frame works as a trailer/ultimate-cast transition but should last <150 ms in gameplay.

hud.notes: tiny guild/name text, coloured by team

fx.readability: Overexposed white against muted sandstone reads instantly, but bloom washes out nearby units.

refs.lighting: Bright daylight, heavy bloom from effect, glitch/RGB-split overlay

refs.title: Two-lane siege map with stylised moat
refs.summary: A stylised stone-and-grass fortress with a turquoise moat lane, a tower with red banner, and two teams clashing; a blue poison/ice AoE cloud sits on the right lane. Overlay text '12 V 12 / two teams, two lanes, one nexus'.
lessons: Separate lanes with strong material contrast: turquoise water channel vs warm sandstone path vs dark mossy pit, readable at a glance from isometric 45 degrees.
Raised grass-topped plateaus with stone walls create level design depth without complex geometry - good low-poly recipe (box + bevel + grass cap).
AoE clouds as flat saturated blue-violet blobs on the ground read clearly against warm stone; keep alpha ~60%.
Translucent white rectangular 'pillars' mark spawn/barrier lines - simple vertical billboard quads with noise.

fx.readability: Cool blue on warm stone is high contrast.

refs.lighting: Overcast-neutral daylight, soft ambient occlusion at wall bases, small torch fires

refs.title: Mech cockpit HUD with target lock
refs.summary: First-person mech cockpit over a lake; a diamond lock-on reticle frames an enemy mech mid-explosion, with arc gauges, AP counter and red off-screen target arrows.
lessons: Centre reticle is a large ~35%-width arc with a diamond lock box; distance readouts sit left/right of the target at the same height so the eye never leaves the centre.
Off-screen enemies are shown as small red triangle chevrons pushed to the screen edges in the direction of the threat.
Vital number (AP 1,025) sits bottom-centre just above the cockpit frame, underlined, ~4% screen height.
Vertical tick ladders at ~25% and ~75% width give speed/altitude without boxes; thin lines keep the view open.

fx.readability: Warm explosion against cool blue-grey water/sky.

refs.lighting: Overcast daylight, cool haze, bright explosion local light

refs.title: Half-timbered canal town at dusk
refs.summary: Real photo of colourful half-timbered houses along a canal with flower boxes and a stone bridge under a dramatic cloudy sky (travel ad).
lessons: Village colour recipe: alternate saturated facade colours (ochre, salmon, yellow, pink) with dark timber framing so each house reads separately.
Foreground magenta flowers + reflective water double the colour and frame the scene - use a water plane with reflection for a golden-hour village.
Roof lines step down toward a vanishing point along the canal to lead the eye.
refs.lighting: Golden hour, warm light on facades, blue sky with broken clouds, reflective water

refs.title: Knight facing mounted enemy in meadow
refs.summary: Third-person view of an armoured knight with teal scarf and shield approaching a mounted enemy in a grassy field; no HUD visible in the crop.
lessons: Camera sits ~2.5 m behind and slightly above the player, player occupying lower-centre ~20% of frame, enemy on the upper-third line.
Dense tall grass with yellow wildflowers and long shadows gives scale; teal cloth accent separates the hero from green/brown terrain.
Mounted enemy is placed on a slight rise so its silhouette breaks the horizon.
refs.lighting: Late afternoon, low warm sun, soft haze in distance

refs.title: Thunder monster lightning burst over water
refs.summary: Huge cyan lightning bolts fork across the frame from a monster attack while the hunter stands in shallow water; floating white debris and a bright cyan bloom fill the right side.
lessons: Lightning reads as jagged polylines with a white 2-3 px core and wide cyan glow (~6x core width); branching bolts span 60-100% of screen width for a boss-level attack.
Pair bolts with a ground-level cyan wash/splash on the water plane so the hit has a 'floor contact'.
Scatter small white debris quads in the air (20-40 pieces) to add depth parallax to an energy burst.
Minimal HUD: tiny compass/minimap emblem bottom-left and party marker top-left, keeping the combat view clean.

fx.readability: Cyan on cyan water can blur; the white core keeps bolts readable.

refs.lighting: Bright daylight with energy-driven cyan bloom

refs.title: Hunter wading toward monster in lagoon
refs.summary: Hunter in a cat-like helmet wades through a shallow teal lagoon toward a spiked monster, framed by a karst mountain and giant rib-like bone arches.
lessons: Giant ribcage/bone arches at frame edges are a cheap, iconic landmark for a monster arena.
Player at left-third, monster at right-third, mountain peak centred above: classic triangle composition for an encounter reveal.
Shallow water with visible ripples around the legs grounds characters; use a transparent plane with a soft depth fade.
refs.lighting: Clear midday sky, soft haze on distant cliffs

refs.title: Toy car in foggy graveyard
refs.summary: A small yellow toy off-roader drives through a foggy gothic graveyard with iron fences, a stone lion and tombstones; a tiny red waypoint marker floats ahead.
lessons: Miniature-scale trick: oversized props (fences, tombs) around a small vehicle + dense distance fog sell 'tiny hero in big world'.
A single saturated object (yellow car) in a desaturated blue-grey fog scene is the only focal point - keep the hero the only warm colour.
Small red diamond marker floating ahead is enough wayfinding; no minimap needed.
Headlight cone on the ground ahead of the car gives direction cue.
refs.lighting: Dense volumetric fog, backlit cold sky top-right, small warm headlights

refs.title: Anime girl riding giant paintbrush
refs.summary: AI anime still of a pink-haired girl in a red coat swinging a giant paintbrush that leaves a sweeping pink paint wave against a blue sky.
lessons: A brush/weapon trail as a thick, solid paint ribbon (not a thin glow) gives a playful, kid-friendly attack effect.
Limit palette to one hero colour (pink/red) against sky blue for maximum pop.
Speed lines via motion-blurred trail edges and splatter droplets at the leading edge.

fx.readability: Very high - complementary red vs blue.

refs.title: Lakeside village with wooden piers
refs.summary: Player-built lakeside town: timber house on a rocky cliff above stacked terraces, wooden boardwalks and a small bridge over crystal-clear turquoise water.
lessons: Vertical stacking (pier level, terrace, cliff house) gives a village 3 readable tiers; put the landmark building on top.
Clear water with visible caustic floor (teal near, deep blue far) is a strong 'welcome' zone visual.
Boardwalk railings and posts repeated every ~1.5 m provide rhythm and guide the eye into the scene.
refs.lighting: Clear midday sun, crisp shadows, slight haze on hills

refs.title: Terraced harbour market with awnings
refs.summary: Player-built cliffside harbour: stone terraces with lattice railings, cloth awnings over market stalls, parasols, barrels and a wooden pier descending to water, with pines and warm-lit rock behind.
lessons: Cloth awnings angled down from walls (olive/khaki) are a cheap way to add shade layers and 'market' identity to a village street.
Lattice railings + repeated parasols create pattern rhythm; repeat props at regular intervals to imply planning.
Warm orange sunlit rock against cool shadowed rock gives depth without extra geometry - bake a warm/cool gradient into cliff materials.
refs.lighting: Late-afternoon sun from the right, warm rim on rock, cool shade under awnings

refs.title: Windmills on golden farmland at dusk
refs.summary: Wooden windmills on rolling wheat-gold fields under a pink-orange hazy sky, with silhouetted round trees and distant mountains; a tiny player stands mid-field.
lessons: Golden-hour recipe: pink-peach sky, orange-gold ground, heavy aerial perspective so mountains become flat pink silhouettes.
Wooden lattice towers with spoked sails are iconic, cheap landmarks; place 2-3 in a cluster at varying distance for depth.
Tiny player vs large props sells open space; the field occupies ~60% of the frame.
refs.lighting: Dusk, low warm sun behind haze, strong pink fog/aerial perspective

refs.title: Skater on sunny seaside promenade
refs.summary: Anime-style illustration of a skateboarder from behind on a seaside promenade with telephone wires, pedestrians, crashing waves and towering cumulus clouds under deep blue sky.
lessons: Painterly cumulus clouds with crisp white highlights on saturated cobalt sky create an instant upbeat mood for kid-friendly scenes.
Converging lines (pavement, wires, buildings) to a vanishing point at ~55% width lead the eye past the character.
Character from behind at right-third lets the player 'project' into the scene - good title/loading screen composition.
refs.lighting: Bright summer midday, strong sun from left, crisp shadows

refs.title: Ally skill board with hex nodes
refs.summary: Ally info screen with parchment frame: left vertical icon tabs (Status, Skills, Equip, Medals, Awaken), large character art centre-left, and a radial skill board of hexagonal/round nodes with costs on the right, Unlock/Unlock All buttons below.
lessons: Left rail of 5 round icon tabs (~7% height each, label beneath) with red notification dots on tabs needing attention.
Skill board is a small radial cluster: one central hex node (current) with 6 surrounding nodes linked by lines, each with a cost badge 'x10' under it; ~35% of screen width.
Character portrait overlaps the panel boundary (bleeds past the frame) to add depth; name/level/class line sits at its feet.
Primary action 'Unlock' as a saturated blue pill, secondary 'Unlock All' as an outlined dark pill next to it; currency counter top-right.

hud.notes: 5 round icons with labels, red dots
heart icon + number in dark pill

refs.title: Armoured cosplayer near gothic chapel
refs.summary: Live-action/photoreal clip of a woman in fantasy armour with round shield on back running past a gothic stone chapel, statue and cypress trees.
lessons: Gothic chapel + cypress trees + bronze statue is a compact 'sacred grounds' set dressing combo.
Gold-trimmed black armour with cream skirt: two-tone costume with metallic trim reads well at distance.

refs.title: Meadow under turquoise cosmic nebula sky
refs.summary: Fast forward dolly through a dark green meadow toward a forested ridge beneath an enormous cyan nebula sky with black ink-like cloud masses and a lens-flare star.
lessons: A surreal skybox (cyan nebula with dark smoky blobs) over a mundane meadow instantly signals 'otherworldly zone'; sky occupies ~45% of frame.
Radial motion blur at the bottom edge sells forward speed - usable as a dash/portal-travel post effect.
Single horizontal anamorphic lens flare streak at top adds a focal light source.

refs.title: Cosmic meadow sky (near-duplicate frame)
refs.summary: Next frame of the same cosmic-meadow clip: cyan nebula sky with black smoke clusters above a forest ridge and blurred meadow.
lessons: Same as IMG_0016: nebula skybox over a grounded scene; keep ground dark and desaturated so the sky stays the hero.

refs.title: Musicians by moonlit waterfall with lanterns
refs.summary: Three figures in Hanfu robes play guzheng and flute on a stone ledge by a moonlit waterfall, with glowing paper lanterns, fireflies and pavilions on cliffs.
lessons: Night-forest warmth recipe: cool blue moonlit background + warm orange lantern point lights at frame corners (bottom-right, left) + green-yellow firefly dots.
Waterfall as a bright vertical light column centre-frame separates foreground figures from dark cliffs.
Robes in cream/peach/gold give a warm triad that pops against navy night.

refs.title: Hero in golden grass beneath pine
refs.summary: Red-haired hero with red scarf crouches in tall backlit grass under a pine trunk; golden sunset haze fills a valley with a misty river and distant spires.
lessons: Backlit grass tips (warm yellow rim on each blade) are the key golden-hour cue; use a sun-facing rim term in the grass shader.
Large dark tree trunk in the foreground at ~45% width frames the shot and adds depth layering (dark fore, mid character, bright hazy back).
Red hero clothing against yellow-green grass keeps the player readable.
refs.lighting: Sunset backlight, strong god-ray haze, warm rim on grass

refs.title: Sunset vista with ruined tower
refs.summary: Golden sunset over a misty forested valley with a dark ruined tower silhouetted left, a floating rock island with dangling roots on the horizon and a hazy lake below.
lessons: Silhouette layering: 4 depth planes (dark cliff left, tower, mid forest, pale hazy far peaks) separated by aerial fog values.
A floating island with hanging roots on the horizon is a distinctive 'goal landmark' that pulls the player.
Sun placed at upper-right third with bright sky gradient; foreground stays below 30% brightness.
refs.lighting: Low sun, thick warm haze/fog, silhouettes, soft god rays

refs.title: Futuristic skybridge walkway at dusk
refs.summary: AI clip of pedestrians on a glossy elevated walkway between neon-screened skyscrapers, with multiple skybridges receding into a blue-hour city.
lessons: Stack horizontal skybridges at 3-4 heights receding to a vanishing point to sell vertical city depth.
Reflective dark floor tiles mirror warm under-soffit strip lights - cheap via screen-space reflections or a roughness ~0.2 floor.
Warm interior lights (left) vs cool blue/violet facades (right) split the frame into temperature zones.
refs.lighting: Blue hour, warm strip lights, emissive LED facades, wet-look reflections

refs.title: Mossy stone stairs to forest shrine
refs.summary: Real photo of moss-covered stone steps leading through a weathered wooden torii gate up to a small shrine in a dense green cedar forest (Kushi Shrine, Nara).
lessons: Gate + long stairs + small distant building is a classic 'pilgrimage' composition: gate frames the goal, stairs converge to it at centre.
Moss on step edges and fallen leaves add wear; use a top-facing green blend in the stone shader.
Soft overcast light under canopy keeps contrast low and mood calm - good for a sanctuary/safe zone.
refs.lighting: Overcast, diffuse green canopy light, no hard shadows

refs.title: Hero climbing ladder in dark well
refs.summary: Painterly isometric view of a character climbing a rope ladder out of a dark stone pit lit by glowing ember cracks; title card 'Lightning Rogue: Rogue + Stormbringer + Archer'.
lessons: Painterly dark-blue stone with small orange ember slits gives danger and warmth points without full lighting.
Character gets a warm local light so it is the brightest thing in a near-black frame.
Build-guide title card in serif small-caps gold text with dark gradient band at bottom ~10% height.
refs.lighting: Dark dungeon, cool blue ambient, warm orange ember accents, character highlight

refs.title: Pixel sprites fighting in 3D meadow
refs.summary: HD-2D style: pixel-art warriors with oversized glowing-blue swords fight on a 3D autumn meadow of yellow/orange flowers beside a slate-roofed wooden barn, red tree and pines.
lessons: Pixel-sprite characters (~6-8% screen height) sit in a fully 3D scene with real perspective; give sprites a blue edge glow on weapons so they read against busy ground.
Ground covered in dense billboard flower clumps (yellow/orange/red) adds colour noise; keep sprites darker/more saturated to stand out.
Low-poly building with chunky shingle roof at frame left is a strong foreground anchor.

fx.readability: Blue glow on blade contrasts warm autumn ground

refs.lighting: Soft daylight, slight tilt-shift/DOF, warm ground

refs.title: Motion-blurred fighter over neon street
refs.summary: AI-generated sideways-rotated still of a figure in mid-strike blurred against a rainy neon Tokyo street with signage bokeh.
lessons: Heavy directional motion blur on a single figure over sharp bokeh lights conveys a dash strike.
Neon signage bokeh (pink, orange, cyan) as background texture adds energy without detail cost.

refs.title: Giant mechanical beast boss in forge
refs.summary: A tiny player character faces a colossal armoured, spiked, chain-bound beast with glowing blue rivets in a red-lit iron forge hall; a smaller purple creature lurks right.
lessons: Boss scale: boss head reaches ~50% screen height while the player is ~6%; the camera stays low to exaggerate size.
Cool blue emissive studs on a warm red-lit boss create focal hotspots and hint weak points.
Red ambient + reflective wet floor + hanging chains = 'forge/lava' zone recipe.
refs.lighting: Red-orange ambient forge light, specular floor, blue emissive accents

refs.title: Pixel-art cliffs, pond and hotbar
refs.summary: Hi-bit pixel-art top-down scene: grassy plateaus over grey stone cliffs, a pond with waterfall, witch and white-haired hero; HP/Stamina bars top-right, 8-slot hotbar bottom-left, round menu buttons bottom-right.
lessons: HP and Stamina as two thin labelled bars stacked top-right (~15% width each) with numeric '82/82' to the right; icon left of each label.
Hotbar of 8 square slots bottom-left (~28% width) inside an ornate feathered frame; first 5 filled, last 3 darker = locked/empty.
4 round utility buttons (Character, Bag, Map, Settings) bottom-right, ~3.5% width each with tiny labels.
Water edge drawn as a thin white animated foam outline around cliffs - simple and highly readable.
refs.lighting: Even daylight, soft drop shadows under trees

refs.title: Throw-targeting circle on forest ruins
refs.summary: Early-alpha creature game: a yellow blob companion, a stump creature enemy with level+HP bar, a yellow ground ring with blue cursor for aiming a throwable item, and a bottom-centre item selector with Switch/Cancel prompts.
lessons: Aiming reticle = yellow glowing disc decal on the ground (~10% width) + a curved yellow arc showing the throw path from player to target.
Overhead bars: level number in a black circle left of the bar; ally bar green, enemy bar red, both ~10% screen width and thin.
Context item selector bottom-centre: single item icon with count '5', up/down chevrons, and controller-button prompts 'Switch'/'Cancel' to its right.
Ancient circular stone ruins with glowing yellow crack lines mark an interactable site.

hud.notes: black circle level, red thin bar

fx.readability: Saturated yellow on muted green/grey ground is very clear

refs.title: Overgrown brutalist apartment terraces
refs.summary: AI still of a weathered white concrete brutalist building with rounded balconies, rooftop palms and pools, in a hazy hillside city; 'D-CITY' title overlay.
lessons: Rounded slab balconies with plants spilling over edges is a strong post-apocalyptic/overgrown architecture motif.
Grime streaks running down from ledges give age cheaply (vertical dark gradient decals).

refs.title: Flower field before giant rising planet
refs.summary: AI clip: a grassy field with red flowers rushing toward the camera beneath a huge looming planet with cyan glowing horizon, black particle swarms and overhanging tree branches.
lessons: Huge planet filling ~40% of the sky behind a thin glowing cyan horizon line creates a 'world-end' set piece.
Overhanging branches top frame + motion-blurred grass bottom frame sandwich the focal planet.

refs.title: Gunner reloading ornate heavy cannon
refs.summary: Close side view of a red-jacketed character crouched with an ornate green-and-brass drum-fed heavy gun, with purple-and-orange flame venting near the breech on a rocky canyon floor.
lessons: Weapon heat/charge shown by a small purple core flash inside orange flame at the breech - two-colour fire reads as 'magic-enhanced'.
Ornate weapon with a big drum magazine silhouette makes the gun readable even in a side-on frame.
Red jacket against desaturated beige rock: one saturated costume piece per character for readability.

refs.title: Starship between twin planets over city
refs.summary: AI sci-fi vista framed by a dark lacy arch: a starship with blue engine trail crosses between two huge planets above a glittering spire city with ring structures.
lessons: Frame a vista with a dark irregular arch (foreground silhouette ~15% border) to focus the eye on the centre.
Two mirrored planet curves converging to a 'V' create a strong central leading shape with a lens-flare star at the apex.
Long blue engine streak from the left gives motion direction into the frame.

refs.title: Boy on hilltop meadow under towering cloud
refs.summary: Anime illustration of a boy seated in a daisy meadow from behind, looking at rolling green hills and a towering cumulus cloud in a deep blue sky with a contrail.
lessons: Towering cumulus as a central vertical landmark above a low horizon (~55% height) gives a hopeful, open mood.
Foreground daisies in focus + soft background hills create depth with only 3 planes.
Saturated cobalt-to-cyan sky gradient + yellow-green grass is a strong cheerful palette for kids' hub worlds.

refs.title: Temple courtyard lit by paper lanterns
refs.summary: Real night photo of a Japanese temple with hanging lanterns, stone lanterns glowing pink/orange, rope ornaments and dark sweeping roofs in blue-green dusk (Hozan-ji, Nara).
lessons: Night shrine recipe: dark teal ambient + many small warm lanterns at different heights (hanging and stone) build depth via light pools.
Each lantern lights only a small radius; leave large dark areas so the warm points carry the composition.
Translucent paper panels glow pink-white - use emissive planes with bloom rather than real point lights for most lanterns.

refs.title: Quiet pond meadow in forest clearing
refs.summary: Photoreal backwoods clearing with a mossy boulder, ferns and reeds in the foreground, a still pond, and a line of broadleaf trees under a pale sky; gothic title overlays.
lessons: Clearing layout: foreground rock + grasses, mid water band, back tree line; each band ~1/3 of the frame height.
Reddish-tipped grass in the foreground breaks up an all-green palette.
Still water reflecting the tree line doubles the visual mass of the backdrop cheaply.

refs.summary: AI clip of a vast concrete underground hall of massive columns with water surging and splashing around their bases under small ceiling lights (Korean caption about a flood tunnel).
lessons: Grid of identical massive pillars receding to a vanishing point creates instant scale for a dungeon/cistern level.
Water surge crests (white foam arcs) at each pillar base give a dynamic 'flooding' hazard read.
Sparse ceiling spotlights in a row reinforce perspective lines.

refs.title: Motorcycle road into galaxy over clouds
refs.summary: AI image of a motorcyclist riding a road that runs over a sea of golden clouds and spirals up into a glowing spiral galaxy.
lessons: A path that curves from the player's feet into a sky landmark is a strong 'journey/level select' visual metaphor.
Golden lit cloud sea under a deep blue starfield: warm-bottom/cool-top split.
Red tail-light as the single warm saturated point on the hero.

refs.title: Little girl with glowing-eyed black cat
refs.summary: AI clip of a blonde little girl in a brown medieval tunic with a small black cat-like familiar with glowing blue eyes on her shoulder, in a blurred castle arena.
lessons: Companion pet perched on the shoulder with emissive blue eyes is an instantly readable 'magic buddy' cue.
Shallow depth of field on the arena background keeps focus on the duo.

refs.title: Stylised stone arch portal gateway
refs.summary: Valheim player-built portal hub: a row of three gothic stone arches with carved tree-pattern lattice infills, cobblestone path and steps leading through the central open arch under bright blue sky and big oak trees.
lessons: Portal hub layout: one open central archway flanked by two decorative closed arches with carved lattice - the open one reads as the path.

refs.title: Surreal street with giant wall eye

refs.title: Raid boss HUD with full MMO layout
refs.summary: Dense MMO raid screen: purple-winged void boss, party frames top-left, boss bar top-centre, minimap + quest tracker top-right, DPS meter and system chat lower-left, and a two-row skill bar bottom-centre around a central level badge splitting HP (red) and MP (blue) bars. refs.title: Little RC drift car and a curious cat on a wooden floor
refs.summary: A white-and-black 1:16-ish RC drift car with working headlights rolls off a marble step onto wood; a grey cat leaps over it like a giant.
refs.concept: RC car racing through a house: pets and household objects as giant obstacles
lessons: The household pet is the perfect RC-game hazard: a giant, fast, unpredictable moving obstacle kids instantly understand.
Floor-level camera (~5–10 cm high) turns a room into a landscape; a step or doorway sill becomes a curb or jump.
Working LED headlights on the toy car make it feel 'real' and give it a face.

refs.title: RC car crossing a shiny marble floor past household 'landmarks'
refs.summary: The RC car drifts across glossy marble tiles; a litter box, a robot vacuum, a cat tree and a crisp packet stand around like buildings.
refs.concept: RC house rally: rooms as tracks, household objects as landmarks
lessons: Scale cues: ordinary objects (robot vacuum, snack bag, chair legs) become landmarks and obstacles; the robot vacuum is a slow patrolling hazard.
Glossy floor reflections of the car and lamps are the miniature version of a wet road: planar/SSR reflection on the floor sells it.
Low camera + some depth-of-field blur in the background = miniature look.

refs.title: FPV simulator view with stick-position overlay and a real controller
refs.summary: A wide fisheye FPV view rolls past a grandstand and a pink gate; two small boxes with crosshairs show the live stick positions; below, hands on a real drone controller.
lessons: Stick overlay: two small squares (~8% width) with a crosshair and a dot per stick, bottom-centre — the best way to teach two-stick (Mode 2) flying.
FPV camera: very wide (~120–150° feel) with barrel distortion and camera uptilt so forward flight looks level.
Gates drawn as thin bright outlines (pink) over the scene read even at high roll angles.
